gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patient with a confirmed histological diagnosis of non-mutated IDH primary glioblastoma (surgical resection or biopsy).

candidate_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] Experimental Arm A: UCPVax + Pembrolizumab + Standard of care
400 mg/m1 every 6 weeks since day 1 until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity for a maximum of 1 year

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: This is a proof-of-concept phase II trial to evaluate the efficacy of maintenance therapy evaluating UCPVax +/- pembrolizumab combined to standard treatment in newly diagnosed unmethylated MGMT glioblastoma.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: UCP specific TCD4 T-cell response will be assess by ex vivo IFN-γ ELISpot in peripheral blood (Adotevi JCO 2023).

role_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] Experimental Arm A: UCPVax + Pembrolizumab + Standard of care

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: The induction of robust tumor reactive CD4 T cell response with UCPVax together with TMZ-mediated immune effects will promote recruitment of effectors immune cells into tumor bed creating a more suitable microenvironment for anti-PD-1 action.

role_evidence.quote: UCPVax (two helper peptides UCP2 and UCP4 + Montanide ISA51) at 0.5 mg subcutaneously at day 1, 8, 15, 29, 36 and 43

agents.drug_class_hint: CD4 T helper-targeted TERT-derived peptide cancer vaccine (UCP2 + UCP4 in Montanide ISA51)

role_evidence.quote: 150-200 mg/m2/day x 5 days per month x 6 months according to best standard of care starting at day 1 of week 1 (with vaccine 1 of UCPVax).

source_quote.quote: Tumor with unmethylated MGMT promoter status

coder_notes: Pembrolizumab is the only pharmacological investigational agent (Arm A only); UCPVax is a peptide cancer vaccine (excluded type) given in Arms A and B. Montanide ISA51 adjuvant is part of the vaccine product and not listed separately. Control Arm C is OTHER-type standard of care, hence control_arm_from_other_arms yes. Pembrolizumab dose written as '400 mg/m1' in record. Immunogenicity endpoint (UCP-specific CD4 ELISpot) measures vaccine response, not pembrolizumab target; target_engagement coded unclear. 'Exploratory biomarker study' outcome has no detail. Tumour treating fields allowed (device, not listed).
